# Northwind Telecom — Devices and handsets FAQ

*Synthetic document. Northwind Telecom is a fictional operator invented for testing; every figure
below is made up and describes no real product, tariff or person.*

## Does Northwind sell handsets?

No. Northwind Telecom sells connections, not handsets. Any unlocked handset that supports the bands
listed below works on the network.

## Which bands are used?

4G on bands 3, 5, 40 and 41; 5G on bands n78 and n28. A handset missing n78 works on the network but
will not reach 5G speeds in most cities.

## Why is my 5G handset showing 4G?

In order of how often it happens: 5G is switched off in the handset's network-mode setting, the
area has no 5G coverage yet, the plan does not include 5G, or the handset lacks band n78. The app's
coverage panel answers the second case for a given address.

## VoLTE and Wi-Fi calling

Both are supported at no charge and are on by default on handsets that declare support. Wi-Fi
calling works on any broadband connection, including another operator's, and calls made over it are
charged as ordinary calls.

## Lost or stolen handset

Bar the connection immediately from the app or by calling 198. Barring stops calls, messages and
data within minutes. A replacement SIM with the same number is issued free of charge against the
original identity document, and the barring is lifted when the replacement is activated.

## Blocking a stolen handset itself

Blocking the handset is separate from barring the connection and is done through the national
device registry using the handset's IMEI, not by Northwind.

## Does a dual-SIM handset need anything special?

No. Both SIM slots work independently. On a handset with one physical slot and one eSIM, see the
eSIM guide.
